category.name: Content Control
category.preferred_workflow: Create StructuredDocumentTag nodes directly with the appropriate SdtType and MarkupLevel, insert them into valid parent containers, configure properties such as Title, Tag, and XmlMapping, and use DocumentBuilder only for text, images, or OLE insertion within the control's paragraph. Generate any required sample inputs (DOCX, images, XML parts) locally before processing.

strict_api_bans: Do not reference Aspose.Words members that do not exist in the current version, such as SdtType.DateTime or StructuredDocumentTag.DateValue.
Avoid invented helper methods like StartStructuredDocumentTag or InsertStructuredDocumentTag overloads that are not part of the API.
canonical_patterns: Instantiate StructuredDocumentTag with a valid SdtType and MarkupLevel, then append child nodes (Run, Paragraph, Table, etc.) as needed.
Use DocumentBuilder to move the cursor into a paragraph inside the SDT before inserting images, OLE objects, or hyperlinks.
nullable_warning_prevention: Initialize all non-nullable reference-type properties (e.g., Title, Tag) when creating a control.
Declare nullable locals for values that may be absent and guard them with null checks before dereferencing.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: Compilation fails with CS0117 or CS1061 because the code references members such as SdtType.DateTime, StructuredDocumentTag.DateValue, or PdfSaveOptions.ShowPlaceholderText.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The example assumes newer or custom extensions that are not present in the documented Aspose.Words API.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Replace the missing members with supported alternatives, for example use a plain-text SDT to hold a formatted date string and set PdfSaveOptions.ShowPlaceholderText via the appropriate property if available.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Consult the official Aspose.Words API reference for each version and limit code to members that exist in the declared package version.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: Build errors CS1501, CS1503, or CS1729 occur when calling methods like InsertOleObject or CustomXmlPart constructors with the wrong number or type of parameters.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The code supplies arguments of incorrect types (e.g., string instead of CustomXmlPart) or omits required parameters.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Pass arguments that match the method signature; for InsertOleObject provide a Stream for the OLE data, a display name string, a boolean for icon display, and optionally a Stream for the icon image.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Reference method overload documentation and use IntelliSense to verify parameter types before coding.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: Runtime throws ArgumentException with the message "Cannot insert a node of this type at this location" when a control is appended to an unsupported parent.
common_failure_patterns.cause: An SDT is inserted directly into a CompositeNode that does not accept that node type, such as inserting a block-level SDT into a Run.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Insert block-level SDTs into Section.Body or Paragraph, and inline SDTs into Paragraph or Run containers. Use DocumentBuilder.MoveTo to position the cursor correctly before insertion.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Validate the target node's NodeType against the SDT's MarkupLevel before calling AppendChild or InsertAfter.

common_failure_patterns.pattern: Missing building block for placeholder name
common_failure_patterns.symptom: InvalidOperationException is thrown when setting StructuredDocumentTag.PlaceholderName without an existing building block of that name.
common_failure_patterns.cause: PlaceholderName requires a BuildingBlock entry in the document's glossary, which the code does not create.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Create a BuildingBlock with the desired name, add it to the document's GlossaryDocument, and then assign PlaceholderName to that block.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Always add the required building block before referencing it as a placeholder.

common_failure_patterns.pattern: Incorrect theme or color API usage
common_failure_patterns.symptom: Compilation fails with CS0246 or CS1061 because types like Theme, ThemeColor, or ThemeColorScheme are not defined, and color conversion errors arise between Aspose.Drawing.Color and System.Drawing.Color.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The code attempts to use theme APIs that belong to a different library version or mixes drawing namespaces.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Use Aspose.Words.Themes.Theme for theme access and Aspose.Drawing.Color for color values; avoid System.Drawing.Color unless explicitly required.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Reference the correct namespace (Aspose.Words.Themes) and keep drawing operations within Aspose.Drawing.

common_failure_patterns.pattern: Missing type imports for table structures
common_failure_patterns.symptom: CS0246 errors indicate that Table, Row, or Cell types cannot be found during compilation.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The required Aspose.Words.Tables namespace is not imported or the project lacks a reference to the assembly containing those types.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Add "using Aspose.Words.Tables;" at the top of the file and ensure the Aspose.Words package version includes the Tables namespace.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Verify that all table-related types are covered by the declared required_namespaces list.

narrative.overview: The Content Control category demonstrates how to manipulate structured document tags (SDTs) in Aspose.Words using supported APIs. Verified examples include inserting plain-text, rich-text, picture, and repeating-section controls, binding them to custom XML, and converting documents while preserving control metadata.
narrative.purpose: Provide an AI coding assistant with clear, standards-compliant patterns for creating, configuring, and processing content controls in Aspose.Words, ensuring that generated code compiles, runs, and respects the library's API surface.
validation_priorities: Ensure that every API call matches the signature defined in Aspose.Words 26.11.0; compilation errors are the highest priority to address.
maintenance_notes: Periodically review the Aspose.Words release notes to update the strict_api_bans list when new members are added or deprecated.
